chunks.arabic_text: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي مَكَّةَ أَيَّامَ مِنًى بَعْدَ فَرَاغِهِ مِنْ زِيَارَةِ الْبَيْتِ فَيَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ تَطَوُّعًا

translations.en: about a man who comes to Mecca during the days of Mina after completing the visitation of the House, then performs tawaf around the House voluntarily
So he said: "Remaining in Mina is more beloved to me."

en.summary: This hadith addresses the practice of returning to Mecca during the days of Mina after completing the ziyārah of the House in order to perform supererogatory tawaf. The Imam عليه السلام indicates a preference for remaining in Mina, showing the greater merit of staying there during those days rather than leaving for voluntary acts in Mecca.
en.seo_question: Is it better to stay in Mina during its days or go to Mecca for voluntary tawaf?

key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Mecca, the sacred city to which the pilgrim goes
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, the hajj site where remaining during its appointed days is preferred here
key_terms.زِيَارَةِ: visitation, here referring to the visit to the House after the rites
key_terms.يَطُوفُ: he performs tawaf, circling the Ka'bah
key_terms.تَطَوُّعًا: voluntarily, as a non-obligatory devotional act
key_terms.الْمُقَامُ: remaining or staying in a place
